businessModel: Yandex ecosystem: search and display ads, Dzen feed, Yandex Plus; browser is a free funnel to Yandex services and Alice AI
updateCadence: Desktop roughly monthly; Android point releases about weekly (YY.M.x numbering)
summary: Yandex Browser is a Chromium-based browser from Russian search company Yandex, tightly integrated with Yandex services and the Alice AI assistant. Strong on features, but data flows to Yandex under Russian jurisdiction.
bestFor: Russian-speaking users inside the Yandex ecosystem
People who want video voice-translation and an AI assistant built in
Android users wanting Chrome Web Store extensions (Alpha/stable)
notFor: Anyone concerned about Russian-jurisdiction data handling
Privacy-focused users (typed URLs and telemetry go to Yandex)
Users outside Russia/CIS wanting English-first UX and support

pros.title: Alice AI built in
pros.detail: Alice AI can chat over any open page in split view (added March 2026), summarise and generate text and images.

pros.title: Chrome Web Store access
pros.detail: Installs Chromium extensions on desktop and, uniquely among mobile browsers, on Android (Alpha and stable per Play listings).

pros.title: Built-in ad blocking and Protect
pros.detail: Ad blocker, Protect security system, Kaspersky download scanning and DNSCrypt support are included.

pros.title: Video translation
pros.detail: Voice-translates foreign-language video, a signature feature rivals lack.

pros.title: All five platforms
pros.detail: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS with Yandex ID sync.

cons.title: Weak privacy
cons.detail: A Trinity College Dublin study (Leith) reported hashed hardware ID and typed URLs sent to Yandex.

cons.title: Russian jurisdiction
cons.detail: Subject to Russian data laws; some governments and employers restrict it.

cons.title: Russian-first UX
cons.detail: Much of the interface and many features default to Russian regions; location choices are limited to Russia/CIS/Turkey.

cons.title: Opaque Chromium lag
cons.detail: Yandex does not publish its Chromium base per release, so patch speed cannot be verified.

faq.q: Does Yandex Browser Alpha for Android support Chrome extensions?
faq.a: Yes. The Google Play listing says it works with Chromium extension stores such as the Chrome Web Store. One recent review reports connection problems after an update.

faq.q: Is Yandex Browser safe to use?
faq.a: It uses the Chromium sandbox plus Yandex Protect, but it sends browsing data to Yandex, a company subject to Russian law.
The browser is developed by Yandex LLC in Russia; the Russian business was separated from Yandex N.V. in 2024 (not re-verified for this entry).
